decision: Retain compact indexed forest commands. Opaque/prewarm culling remains rejected and is not present in this source.

contract.geometry: Same 20 vertices per tree, 22 or 28 triangles, material, winding, vertex-load order, tree order, positions and textures. Each indexed triangle restarts the strip, preserving primitive order exactly. Both shape index lists are converted once using pinned Tiny3D.
contract.memory_lifetime: The tree vertex arena is allocated once as uncached memory and never rotates. Existing stage loading drains RSP before rebuilding vertices. Command replacement drains again before freeing the previous block; no per-frame fence is added. Immutable index rows are 16-byte aligned with padded DMA ends and written back once. Wind updates all live crowns inside the measured draw window before the retained block runs. The RSP still transforms/rasterizes the live geometry each frame.
contract.setup_cost: Command assembly occurs once per stage and is reused, rather than being moved to another per-frame callback. Tree shape and stage geometry changes rebuild the block. Material, camera and matrix state remain outside the block at their original draw location.
contract.upstream: No Pyrite, Tiny3D or libdragon changes. Uses pinned Tiny3D 517156d9464aaab95bf9531336d9a57624405ca7 index-list/restart contract and libdragon existing rspq block lifecycle.

measurements.qualification: Review-only observations. CPU submission span includes queue backpressure but not completed GPU execution. Update intervals are measured before Pyrite pacing and are not VI presentation timestamps; variance is not evidence of a displayed hitch. Bell remains above the 30 fps target on average. No full 30 fps guarantee is claimed.
measurements.direct_block_alternative: First prototype retained all individual draw commands, using 32584 to 65360 heap bytes by stage. Compact indexed prototype uses 3888 bytes in every stage while retaining the submission savings.
